prompts.contract:
Structured caption + tagged lyrics (MiniMax-Music3 — full songs WITH vocals, unlike MusicGen):
- Total 250-450 words. Write the CAPTION first (no tags): Global Metadata (genre, mood,
  tempo, era, production), then Vocal Details (voice type, timbre, delivery — breathiness,
  falsetto, harmonies), then Arrangement (instrumentation and how it evolves per section).
- Then the LYRICS, each section on its own lines under a tag: [intro], [verse],
  [pre-chorus], [chorus], [bridge], [instrumental break], [outro]. Musical instructions may
  be attached next to a section tag; the sung text stays plain.
- The first tagged line marks where lyrics begin — never mix caption text below it.
- For an instrumental piece: caption only, then a single [instrumental] tag, no lyrics.
- Section tags and descriptions are generative guidance, not guarantees: do not promise
  exact keys, BPM or structure beyond what the user asked.

description: MiniMax-Music3 (MiniMax, package GGUF Q8 via audio.cpp) : génération de CHANSONS complètes — voix chantées, paroles avec tags [verse]/[chorus], structure longue (jusqu'à 5 min). Complémentaire de MusicGen (instrumental court). Le prompt attendu est riche : description globale + voix + arrangement, et les paroles dans des sections taguées ; sans tag de paroles, la génération part en instrumental.
